title: Update 23.2 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2023 Release Wave 2
summary: Update 23.2 for Business Central 2023 Release Wave 2 includes hotfixes, VAT posting improvements, generative AI integration, enhanced Dynamics GP migration troubleshooting, and localization features for Denmark including e-invoicing and digital vouchers.
features: Improved data upgrade troubleshooting for Dynamics GP migration
Generative AI integration in AL solutions
VAT posting in General Ledger setup
New operational limits on scheduled tasks and web requests
